en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a lakeside or pond scene with small rowboats carrying people in the foreground. Behind the water is a tree‑lined shore with tall birch trees partially obscuring a large traditional inn or guesthouse building. The caption at the bottom reads in German "Moritzburg bei Dresden — Adams Gasthof." The overall style suggests an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.
